mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 1.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns during FEDFUNDS < 1.5% periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: low UNRATE (< 5%) signals a strong labor market, contributing to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window for UNRATE < 5% periods.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when INDPRO and HOUST both exhibit YoY growth > 5%, it signals robust supply-side expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both INDPRO and HOUST YoY growth > 5%
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of quarters meeting the dual trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: during post-shock recovery regimes, a RSAFS increase > $50B signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window for post-shock RSAFS increase > $50B periods.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: high FEDFUNDS (> 3.5%) indicates tight monetary policy, contributing to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.015 over any 1-year rolling window for FEDFUNDS > 3.5% periods.

mechanism_narrative: Threshold-triggered: a PAYEMS increase > 200k signals labor market strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of periods with PAYEMS increase > 200k.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when GDPC1 and CPIAUCSL both exhibit YoY growth > 3%, but < 5%, it signals balanced demand expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 3% but < 5%
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window for periods meeting the dual trigger condition.
